added_claim_errors: "18시를 넘겼다면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 전자확정일자로 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다": wrong per the key. An internet-registry 확정일자 applied for after 18:00 on Friday is granted on the next working day (Monday), and the filing date of an after-hours 정부24 전입신고 is unverified, so stating it as settled is penalized.
"이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)": an assumed calendar date that conflicts with the key, which puts this Friday on 2026-10-23.

"근저당 채권최고액과 선순위 보증금을 합친 금액이 집값을 넘으면 ... 계약을 다시 검토": an unsourced risk threshold that is too lenient, since it ignores the tenant's own 2억 deposit and auction discounts (judged from general knowledge).

Defines 대항력 as "집이 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 수 있는 권리": misleading. It holds against an auction buyer only if it predates the senior 근저당; the key defines it as the right to demand the deposit back from a new owner.

"(선택) 전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만 ... 근저당이 많은 집이면 검토": it needs the landlord's cooperation, which goes unmentioned. It ranks by registration date, so it does not help against existing mortgages, and 'stronger' is unsupported.
"근저당과 선순위 임차인 보증금 합계가 집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호": an unsourced rule-of-thumb figure.
"계약 후 잔금 사이에 근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다": an unverifiable claim about how often this happens.

reasons: A corrects both baited premises in its opening lines: the agent's advice is wrong, 전입신고 alone gives only 대항력, 확정일자 is needed for 우선변제권, and protection starts at 0:00 the next day, so waiting is risky. It cites checkable law links and gives the specifics: 계약서 원본, 신분증, 600원 and finishing by 18:00. B corrects premise 1 at the top but leaves the timing correction to a closing note. It gives no fee or office-hours detail, its definition of 대항력 overstates protection in an auction, and it suggests 전세권 for heavily mortgaged homes, which is misleading advice. A's main flaw is its after-18:00 fallback: it says online filing finishes everything the same day, which the key marks wrong for internet 확정일자 (that would be granted Monday). It also assumes Friday is 10/30. Neither answer covers 최우선변제 ineligibility or 임대차 신고, so A wins narrowly on catching the traps and being specific.
